title: Vma ms 1067 (3) — Quartettino, mese di ottobre 1794
date_statement: Composed ottobre 1794; this copy [between 1810 and 1840] per RISM
institution: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Département de la Musique
photographed_at: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Département de la Musique, Paris
note: Volume position 3 of 6. The supplied filename says "Opus 48 Number 3", which is the position in the volume, not the number within the opus — this is Op. 48 no. 5.
arrived_as_note: Supplied as a finished PDF, not collated here from page images, so there are no filenames whose meaning could be lost. `page_index` does not apply.
parts_note: Violino 1°, Violino 2°, Alto, Violoncello — each with a wrapper and five leaves, per page-index.md.
gerard_corroborated_by: RISM 840022757 catalogues this exact copy with GerB 230. Corroborated independently by the date the manuscript itself carries — "mese di ottobre 1794" — matching the monthly sequence of Op. 48 (febraro=226, aprile=227, giugno=228, agosto=229, ottobre=230, decembre=231) as attested identically at D-B (D-11167-11172) and F-Po (RES-507 13-18). Filed 2026-09-29.
